name: cron
label: Cron
description: Manage scheduled cron jobs — list, add, update, remove, run, and view run history. Supports reminders and recurring tasks.

jobId.description: The unique identifier of the cron job to target

job.description: Full job definition object — includes name, schedule, payload, sessionTarget, and optional delivery/enabled fields. See OpenClaw docs for schema.

patch.description: Partial job update — only include the fields you want to change (e.g. schedule, payload, enabled)

text.description: Wake event text or reminder content

includeDisabled.description: Include disabled jobs in the list

mode.description: Wake mode — trigger immediately or on next heartbeat

runMode.description: Run mode — only if due, or force regardless of schedule

contextMessages.description: Number of recent conversation messages to include as context (0-10)

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the operation
